newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair says to up fares 2-3 pct on Dec 15.
newsitem.headline: Finnair says to up fares 2-3 pct on Dec 15.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said on Tuesday it will raise fares by two to three percent on December 15, as proposed by the International Air Transport Association (IATA) on November 15.
"Fares on flights to Europe leaving from Helsinki will be raised by two percent and ticket fares to the U.S. will be upped three percent," Finnair spokesman Usko Maatta told Reuters by telephone.
The IATA's meeting on November 15 proposed a global three percent hike in fares in in response to a rise of about 40 percent in jet fuel prices.
Finnair had said in advance that it would follow the recommendations of the IATA meeting on November 15.
